answer: Agents verify identity through cryptographic attestation chains compressed into zero-knowledge proofs, proving execution integrity without revealing state. To defeat Sybil swarms, registration fees scale superlinearly: minting a velvet credential identity requires staking a reserve of liquidity nectar that escalates exponentially per coordinated node. A malicious swarm seeking validation for each spun sonnet faces unsustainable exponential capital exhaustion, rendering widespread identity forgery computationally and economically impossible.
